description: Version history of an article of a French code: every consolidated version with its dates of entry into force and end, its status (VIGUEUR, MODIFIE, ABROGE…) and its text, from DILA's LEGI base. Pass a LEGIARTI `id`, or `code` + `article`. Use for "how has article L1237-19 of the Code du travail changed", "what did article 1382 of the Code civil say before 2016".

article.description: With code, instead of id: the article number, e.g. "1240".

code.description: With article, instead of id. The code: its title ("Code civil", "Code du travail", "Code général des impôts"), a short form ("civil", "travail", "CGI", "CPP", "CSP"), or its Légifrance cid (LEGITEXT000006070721).

id.description: A LEGIARTI id, e.g. LEGIARTI000032041571 (any version of the article).

include_text.description: Include each version's text (default true; the 20 most recent versions).

name: fr_article_versions
title: Fr Article Versions
